searchText: I would like to contribute to Ethereum development, but I'm not sure how to start. Last few weeks I was lurking around the server, trying to figure out and learn more about ongoing/upcoming projects. Is there any team that needs help at the moment / in the recent future? Personally, Statelessness is the most interesting area, but I would consider other things as well. I have ~15 years of experience as Software Engineer, last 1.5 years in blockchain/web3 space. I recently learned about Protocol Fellowship and seams like it might be good fit for me. Any idea when 5th cohort is expected to start? I think I can contribute and get up to speed on my own (with some minimum guide), so I would rather not wait for 5th cohort if it is too far away. The Portal Network is stateless adjacent and they have their own Discord server if that interests you. At the least, I recommend looking into it. Are you looking for paid work or open source (unpaid) projects? Portal Network is related to ENS smart contracts right? or is it built into the spec? just checking it out now looks cool Is their Discord server public (and can I get the link) or restricted to developers (in that case, how to reach out to them)? I'm not sure I can commit full-time for the next few months (let's say until the end of the year), so I was planning to use that time to learn about project(s) and get up to speed. And if everything goes ok, to transition to full-time and also get paid. https://discord.gg/9GV4MJCwgf <@235495902888853504> <@261161007982968833> It has nothing to do with ENS. Thanks
